title: CourseAsCode Wiki Activity
description: Schema for WKI_*.yaml Wiki activity files

Type.description: Activity type identifier — must be WIKI (case-insensitive)

Description.description: Short description shown on the course page

Intro.description: Introduction text shown at the top of the wiki

FirstPageTitle.description: Title of the wiki's first (home) page

WikiMode.description: Collaborative: all students share one wiki; Individual: each student has their own wiki

WikiFormat.description: Default markup format for wiki pages

ForceFormat.description: Prevent users from changing the wiki format

EditBegin.description: Unix timestamp — start of editing window (0 = no restriction)

EditEnd.description: Unix timestamp — end of editing window (0 = no restriction)
